a:What is CodeSpectra?: A skills-assessment and hackathon platform for hiring teams and colleges. It turns a long list of applicants into a ranked shortlist based on work each candidate actually did. Candidates also get free practice on the same platform.
a:How do I get started?: Candidates can create an account and start practising for free. Hiring teams and colleges can book a pilot from the contact page.
q:What kinds of questions can an assessm: What kinds of questions can an assessment include?
a:What kinds of questions can an assessm: Coding with hidden test cases, multiple choice, true or false, fill-in-the-blank, written answers and CAD design tasks, all in one test.
q:Is it only for software developers?: Is it only for software developers?
a:Is it only for software developers?: No. Besides coding roles such as Java, Python, JavaScript and SQL, you can assess QA automation, mechanical CAD, drawing review, aptitude and written answers.
a:How are candidates scored?: Questions are weighted by difficulty: easy questions score 3 points, medium 4 and hard 5. Everyone in a screening is scored the same way and ranked on one list.
a:What does proctoring check?: Fullscreen lock, tab-switch detection, webcam face matching against the ID photo, copy-paste blocking and second-screen detection. Every event is timestamped on the report and a reviewer decides what it means.
a:Do you check for plagiarism?: Yes. Code answers are compared across everyone who took the same test.
q:Can we share results with candidates?: Can we share results with candidates?
a:Can we share results with candidates?: Yes. You can release scores to candidates or download the results as a CSV file.
a:How do hackathons work?: Teams of up to five join with one link, claim problems and submit a repository. Judges score each entry out of 100 on a shared rubric, then release results.
a:Can I connect GitHub?: Yes. GitHub is connected through OAuth, so CodeSpectra never asks for your GitHub password.
q:Can our organization use single sign-o: Can our organization use single sign-on?
a:Can our organization use single sign-o: Yes. Organizations can sign in through their own SAML or OIDC identity provider, such as Okta, Azure AD or Google Workspace.
a:Where can I see prices?: The pricing page always shows the current plans and prices.
a:Can I cancel my subscription?: Yes, from the Billing settings in your dashboard at any time.
a:What is your refund policy?: Fees are non-refundable except where required by law. The Terms of Service have the details.
a:How is my data protected?: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and dashboards use role-based access. The Security page explains more.
q:Can I export or delete my data?: Can I export or delete my data?
a:Can I export or delete my data?: Yes. Email privacy@codespectra.ai to access, export or delete your personal data. The Privacy Policy lists your rights and how long each kind of data is kept.
a:Can I change plans anytime?: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle unless otherwise noted.
a:Is there a free tier?: Yes. You can start on the free plan and move to paid plans when you need more capacity.
q:What payment methods do you accept?: What payment methods do you accept?
a:What payment methods do you accept?: We accept major credit cards via Stripe. Enterprise billing options may be available on request.
q:Do you offer discounts for annual bill: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
a:Do you offer discounts for annual bill: Yes. Annual plans are discounted versus paying monthly (typically around {pct}% less than twelve monthly payments for Pro).
